description_en: Submits an asynchronous image moderation task. Asynchronous moderation tasks do not return moderation results in real time. You must obtain the results by using a callback or polling. The moderation results are retained for up to 3 days
description_zh: 图片异步检测接口，异步检测任务不会实时返回检测结果，您需要通过callback或者轮询的方式获取检测结果。检测结果最长保留3天
name: ImageAsyncModeration

parameters.help_en:
The moderation services supported by Image Moderation Enhancement Edition. Valid values:
baselineCheck: General baseline check.
baselineCheck_pro: General baseline check - Professional Edition.
baselineCheck_cb: General baseline check - Overseas Edition.
tonalityImprove: Content governance moderation.
aigcCheck: AIGC image moderation.
profilePhotoCheck: Profile photo moderation.
advertisingCheck: Marketing material moderation.
liveStreamCheck: Video or live stream snapshot moderation
parameters.help_zh:
图片检测增强版支持的检测服务。取值：
baselineCheck：通用基线检测
baselineCheck_pro：通用基线检测_专业版
baselineCheck_cb：通用基线检测_海外版
tonalityImprove：内容治理检测
aigcCheck：AIGC图片检测
profilePhotoCheck：头像图片检测
advertisingCheck：营销素材检测
liveStreamCheck：视频\直播截图检测
parameters.name: service

parameters.help_en: The parameter set for the content moderation object in JSON character string format. When you specify imageUrl, the URL must be accessible from the Content Moderation backend via Direct Internet Access. Internal network URLs that require authentication, private links with access restrictions, or temporarily invalid URLs are not supported. Otherwise, a download error(imageUrl) fault is returned
parameters.help_zh: 内容检测对象的相关参数集，JSON 字符串格式。当传入 imageUrl 时，该地址需可从内容安全服务后端通过公网直接访问，不支持需要鉴权的内网地址、带访问限制的私有链接或临时失效的地址，否则会返回 download error(imageUrl) 错误
parameters.name: service_parameters

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The results of the asynchronous image moderation
Data.description_zh: 图片异步检测后的结果

DataId.description_en: The value of the dataId parameter passed in the API request. If this parameter is not passed in the request, this field is not returned
DataId.description_zh: API请求时传入的dataId 的值，如请求时未传入，则没有该字段

ReqId.description_en: The reqId field returned by the Image Moderation Enhancement Edition API. This field is active for Field-specific search of the moderation results
ReqId.description_zh: 图片异步审核增强版API返回的reqId字段，可用此字段查询检测结果

Msg.description_en: The response message for the request

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
